name: Dai Takashi
source:
Working as one of Kanako's employees, he also is part of the Order's "Adult Bank" squad. His Cybody Tzadikt has armor that resembles a samurai's hakama and kataginu, reflecting his practice of kendo swordsmanship, and fights with the Star Sword "Amethyste", which resembles a Japanese blade. Like [url=/c80912]Takuto[/url], [url=/c80913]Wako[/url], [url=/c80914]Sugata[/url] and [url=/c82995]Head[/url], he also bears a true mark which allows him to directly control a Cybody without a Cybercasket which he uses to fight once again with Simone's Daletos. [spoiler]He was defeated by Takuto. He later transfers into Head's "Vanishing Age" after the release of the West Maiden's seal, since only Star Drivers with true marks can apprivoise now that the Crux has reached the Third Phase, despite his Cybody still being destroyed. He later requests to return to Adult Bank - a request which Kanako accepts. At the end of the anime, he helps Takuto when the other members of the Glittering Crux acquire their true marks.[/spoiler]

[From [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Star_Driver_characters##Glittering_Crux_Brigade]Wikipedia[/url].]
